title: Total net official development assistance to medical research and basic health sectors
national_indicator_available: This indicator is not applicable to Rwanda.
national_indicator_description: This indicator concerns official flows (official development assistance plus other official flows) to be reported by donors. As Rwanda is not a donor, this indicator is not applicable.
indicator_definition: Total ODA flows to developing countries quantify the public effort that donors provide to developing countries for medical research and basic health.
un_custodian_agency: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)
